cues: Rigid templated structure: Classification, 'Key decisions (resolved up front)' table with Default and Revisit trigger columns, First end-to-end slice, Phases, Cross-cutting, AI layer, Deferred
Explicit N/A rows for '(AI) prompt+RAG vs fine-tune' and an 'AI layer' section stating 'doesn't apply' for a non-AI system, which suggests a checklist that was followed mechanically
Phase 0 is a 'walking skeleton' with a single real request, tiers crossed, and 'deployed, logged, monitored on day zero', plus an exit check
Each phase has 'Unlocks', 'Depends on' and 'Exit check' fields, and ordering is justified by dependency and widest impact; the plan says 'rollback before scale' and puts the visible portal last
Per-phase cross-cutting matrix (security/observability/reproducibility/resilience) and a Deferred list where every item has a pull-forward trigger
